# HP-16 paired-review differential and trust-boundary review

Baseline `05c7131`. Current command/test/input source is bound by the
[qualification receipt](../evidence/prose-headless/2026-10-25-paired-review/receipt.json).
Recommendation: admit this bounded offline comparison source after the recorded
full gate. Final independent source review found no remaining blocker in repaired
sites. This is not provider, document, human, publication or UI qualification.

## Scope and method

Applied differential-review and sharp-edges to paired input/CLI/audit code,
documentReviewer template selection, main dispatch, CUE and relevant existing
journal/native transport owners. Fathom review_diff/obligations answered from the
05c7131 index and identified stale uncommitted source; its unrelated findings were
not used as a verdict. Current source and actual parent entrypoint tests govern.
Systematic debugging traced the unknown-cost test failure and latency overflow.

The new code stays in cmd/prose-lab. Existing SDK transport, native encoder,
locked journal, source fixtures and request/replay helpers remain owners. No
exported library, dependency, hook, global config or consumer change occurred.
The optional template field defaults to the old prompt/method, and all 67 old wire
digests plus the retained real 67-outcome report remain unchanged on replay.

## Findings and dispositions

| Ref | Counterexample | Final disposition |
|---|---|---|
| SC-F1 | qualified=true with incomplete totals passed CUE | Qualified totals require 140/70/70 known completions and no unknown/incomplete/invalid/candidate error |
| SC-F2 | Paired study used generic provider/output bounds | Paired CUE requires Anthropic and 1..8192 output tokens, agreeing with Go |
| SC-F3 | Pending/unknown attempt accepted an unused reason filename | Per-state artifact allowance rejects unconsumed/extra files |
| SC-F4 | Clean counters with missing/invalid/inconclusive row still qualified in CUE | Qualified row type permits only supported/unsupported; negative actual-report mutations retained |
| SC-F5 | Two maximum int64 outcome latencies wrapped the report total | Nonnegative checked sum refuses on overflow before JSON emission |

The unknown-usage parent oracle initially failed because it assumed report JSON
must exist. Actual flow retains the full 1001 synthetic-microdollar reservation,
records unknown with no priced cost, closes the writer and preserves its lock.
Read-only report refuses the locked journal; the next capture refuses before HTTP.
The test was corrected to those instruments. The implementation's lock was preserved.

## Trust and residual boundaries

The root-owned cohort and label-source raw pins prevent a caller from silently
substituting a new dataset. Source/provenance bytes and facts are cross-checked;
this proves declared lineage, not an authenticated person or original fact truth.
Budget prior and caps are frozen caller declarations, not an account balance.
The source/artifact directories require operator custody; hashes do not create
an atomic hostile-filesystem snapshot or cryptographic provider attestation.

Only explicit capture --live dispatches. Common bindings include both variants
and exact request bytes; one journal serializes the 140 execution prefix. Candidate
mismatch stops later calls, while a baseline semantic mismatch permits its paired
candidate. Corrupt/uncertain accounting outranks an apparent known mismatch.
Missing later work remains represented, never substituted by successful rows.

Default output excludes source/oracle/provenance/reasons; content opt-in deliberately
exports them. JSON is bounded/encoded before writing; short/error writes return 2,
but accepted stdout bytes cannot be revoked. Authority/adoption flags stay false.
Fixed output codes do not authorize effects or replace consumer identity/policy.

Actual parent race, CUE, native-replay, compiled-CLI and compiler evidence is in the
separate receipt. Critics reviewed source, not paid model quality. Cross-builds
are not native Windows/Linux permissions/runtime qualification. No fuzz/coverage
percentage, population calibration, economic saving or production adoption was measured.

## Actual HP-17 trial follow-up

The separately frozen [paid trial](../evidence/prose-headless/2026-10-25-paired-live/README.md)
stopped at108/140 on the first candidate/fixed-positive mismatch. All native
accounting reconciled to $0.354276, with32 positions unexecuted and zero unknown.
No new framing regression was reached. Blind source review found strict-entailment
ambiguity in the positive runbook paraphrase; the failed study and label remain
unchanged. [0047](../intent/decisions/0047-qualify-oracle-semantics-before-prompt-tuning.md)
selects offline source/criterion qualification before more tuning. No model
adoption, generation, long-document, human or UI gate closes.
